description: Every field a call to comic may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

brief.description: what to explain and the angle to take: the concept, who is confused by it, where the joke is; the ask when left out

output.description: where to write the PNG; comics/<title>.png when left out

panels.description: how many panels, 1 to 6; left out, the model picks three to five, or one for a gag

renderer.description: gpu, cpu, or auto (left out): the GPU when there is one, the same picture on the CPU when there is none

rounds.description: how many times the model may fix what the strip measured; 3 when left out

script.description: a strip's PNG from an earlier call (it carries its script), or a .comic.json, to draw again; with a brief, changed as the brief asks

seed.description: a number that fixes the hand's wobble; the same script and seed draw the same picture

title: What comic takes (craft-agent/1)
